Amazing Food - OMG
May 2026 • Family
I needed to find a good Japanese restaurant that my kids would eat in. They are fussy eaters, and have only been eating mainly rice on our trip. 

Well - as we walked through the doors, the staff was amazing, spoke good English and sat us down up stairs.

Tip - sit upstairs for a quieter atmosphere.

The selection on the menu was super extensive, and the food was amazing.

And yes my kids ate extremely well, trying different foods, from sushi, to chicken to meat. 

Highlight food experience of our trip in Danang at an affordable price!

4 people plus an alcoholic drink for $58 au!
